source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD11A2.061 8-day land surface temperature, tile h19v04 (LP DAAC)

confidence.note: Averaged over cropland pixels only (≥ 50 % ESA WorldCover 2021 'cropland' inside the pixel). Not available for Vâlcea county and the few communes outside the downloaded WorldCover tiles (south of 45 °N / west of 21 °E). Clear-sky only (cloudy days are missing, so cloudy months are biased warm by day). Surface (skin) temperature at the ~10:30 / ~22:30 Terra overpass, not air temperature; one 8-day composite (2022-10-16) is missing.

label: Night-time land surface temperature on cropland
